verdict.rationale: There is no documented bulk export or data-portability feature. Data can only be pulled out piecemeal: the MCP server exposes account data (nexus, filings, registrations, transactions, sales, products, certificates) as agent-callable tools, and the API lets you list and retrieve certificates with download URLs. Month-to-month billing with no required contract makes leaving straightforward. Missing for 10: a documented full-account export, explicit open export formats (CSV/JSON dumps), documented list endpoints for transactions and filings, an offboarding or data-retention policy, and independent corroboration.
